scripts.preinstall: sh -c 'rm -f package-lock.json yarn.lock; case "$npm_config_user_agent" in pnpm/*) ;; *) echo "Use pnpm instead" >&2; exit 1 ;; esac'
scripts.build: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm -r --if-present run build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:libs && pnpm -r --filter "./artifacts/**" --filter "./scripts" --if-present run typecheck
scripts.test:perf: pnpm --filter @workspace/db run sync && pnpm --filter @workspace/api-server exec node --experimental-test-module-mocks --import tsx --test test/funnel-perf-budget.test.ts test/cycle-perf-budget.test.ts
scripts.test:hardening: pnpm --filter @workspace/db run sync && pnpm --filter @workspace/api-server exec node --import tsx --test test/global-error-handler-envelope.test.ts test/tenant-isolation.test.ts test/assert-dev-tenant-header-safe.test.ts
scripts.check: pnpm run typecheck:libs && pnpm run test:hardening && pnpm run test:perf && pnpm run test:a11y
